div.p: Your pass for Open Source Village is active from to . Your member number is .

1. Sign in to Open Source Village. This link signs you in once, without a password, and expires on . Later, sign in at with your e-mail address: you get a new sign-in link by mail each time (or present your pass).

a.style: display: inline-block; background-color: #d6ff52; color: #1a231d; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px;

p.a: Sign in to Open Source Village

t.p: 2. Add the pass to your wallet. Open this page and scan the code with your EUDI wallet (or another OpenID4VCI wallet); the pass certificate shows your tier and validity at the door and signs you in to the apps:

a.style: display: inline-block; background-color: #d6ff52; color: #1a231d; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px;

p.a: Add the pass to your wallet

t.p: No wallet? Show your pass as a QR code from your phone instead: (signed in, no wallet needed).
Your village tokens. Open this link to put them into your wallet and pass them on to other participants. They have no monetary value.

a.style: display: inline-block; background-color: #d6ff52; color: #1a231d; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px;

div.p: 3. Use the community apps. Open and choose "Sign in with Open Source Village". Your Nostr key is kept safe by Belfry; your public key is .
If the link has expired, just sign in with your e-mail address as described above.
